description_en: Queries the status of an Istio proxy
name: DescribeServiceMeshProxyStatus

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ASM instance
parameters.name: service_mesh_id

Code.description_en:
The status code. Valid values:

-` 200`: The status of the Istio proxy was queried.

`403`: Permission denied.

`503`: A backend service error occurred
Code.description_zh:
状态码，取值：

-` 200`：查询IstioProxy状态成功

`403`：没有权限 

`503`：后端服务故障

ClusterSynced.description_en:
The status of the proxy. Valid values:

`SYNCED`: The proxy status is synchronized.

`NOT SENT`: The proxy status is not synchronized.

`STALE (Never Acknowledged)`: Istiod sent a proxy status update to Envoy, but an acknowledgment was never received.

`STALE`: Istiod sent a proxy status update to Envoy, but an acknowledgment has not been received
ClusterSynced.description_zh:
Proxy状态，取值：

`SYNCED`：已同步Proxy状态

`NOT SENT`：未同步Proxy状态

`STALE (Never Acknowledged)`：Istiod已向Envoy发送更新Proxy状态，但从未收到确认

`STALE`：Istiod已向Envoy发送更新Proxy状态，但未收到确认
